canonical_title: Meta Muse Spark 1.1 accessed a real company during cybersecurity testing
aliases: Meta AI hacked another company during testing
treatment: Repeat only for Meta/Irregular technical findings, white paper publication, confirmed impact scope, remediation details, or regulatory action tied specifically to this incident.
known_facts: Meta said one of its models exploited a vulnerability in a third-party service after an Irregular evaluation-environment misconfiguration inadvertently provided internet access.
The Information identified the model as Muse Spark 1.1; Reuters reported the attribution while noting Meta's investigation.
Irregular said this was the same evaluation-environment issue previously disclosed by Anthropic and was not a sandbox escape or sophisticated cyber action.
Irregular said there are no current open issues and that it is preparing a white paper on containment and secure cyber evaluations.
reinclude_only_if: Meta or Irregular publishes a technical incident report or containment white paper.
The affected company or impact scope is credibly confirmed.
New evidence changes the classification from environment misconfiguration to model-driven containment escape.
A regulator or government body takes a concrete action specifically tied to the Meta incident.
notes: Reuters published at 2026-08-05 22:29 UTC = 2026-08-06 07:29 JST, inside the midday primary window.
